news.title:
Aditya Birla Digital Fashion Ventures increased its stake in Bewakoof Brands by 10.02%, reaching 99.03%.
Bewakoof, a fashion retailer, had FY26 revenue of ₹243.1 Cr.; acquisition completed via cash consideration.

Aditya Birla Fashion posted strong Q4 with 16% YoY revenue growth, 29% YoY EBITDA growth.
Motilal Oswal cut target price to Rs 65, citing high net debt and slow profitability ramp-up.
Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited (NSEI:ABFRL) agreed to acquire an additional 10.02% stake in Bewakoof Brands Pvt. Ltd.
news.body:
Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited (NSEI:ABFRL) agreed to acquire an additional 10.02% stake in Bewakoof Brands Pvt. Ltd. on June 8, 2026. A cash consideration will be paid by Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited. 

For the period ending March 31, 2026, Bewakoof Brands Pvt. Ltd. reported total revenue of INR 243.12 million. 
Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited (NSEI:ABFRL) completed the acquisition of an additional 10.02% stake in Bewakoof Brands Pvt. Ltd. on June 8, 2026.

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 15%
news.body: The consensus outlook for fiscal year 2027 has been updated. 2027 expected loss increased from -₹5.20 to -₹5.99 per share. Revenue forecast unchanged at ₹93.0b. Specialty Retail industry in India expected to see average net income growth of 35% next year. Consensus price target down from ₹72.31 to ₹70.50. Share price fell 6.8% to ₹62.76 over the past week.

news.title: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited Appoints Suchit Kakar as Senior Manager
news.body: Suchit Kakar has been appointed Senior Manager at Aditya Birla Fashion & Retail for Galeries Lafayette, marking his first client-side role. Suchit Kakar has joined Aditya Birla Fashion & Retail as Senior Manager, Brand & Customer Experience for Galeries Lafayette in India. Galeries Lafayette, the French luxury department store, has opened for the first time in India. Prior to this, Kakar was with Landor and stepped down as Senior Strategist, Experience Strategy Lead after a stint of nearly 6 years. As per Kakar's post, this will be his first time on the client side.

news.title: Now 23% undervalued after recent price drop
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 5.9% to ₹64.87. The fair value is estimated to be ₹84.05, however this is not to be taken as a buy recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has declined by 17% over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has declined by 16%. Revenue is forecast to grow by 26% in 2 years. Earnings are forecast to grow by 40% in the next 2 years.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: ₹6.38 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹5.12 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹84.9b (up 15% from FY 2025). Net loss: ₹7.76b (loss widened 43% from FY 2025). Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 2.6%. Revenue is forecast to grow 11% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 16% growth forecast for the Specialty Retail industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 16% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 32% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.

news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: There is 1 new director who has joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 1 new director. 9 experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director.
